Thought: All 1x1 convs give 0.354, worse than all 3x3 convs (0.411). So 3x3 convs are better. Let me try mixing 3x3 convs with some 1x1 convs or skip connections in strategic positions. In NAS-Bench-201, the optimal architecture often has nor_conv_3x3 on most edges. Let me try variations where I replace one 3x3 conv with something else to see the effect of each edge.
